_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own flagship (sis_ship.c) and Ilwrath (ilwrath.c) in its own battle engine, recorded by the program battle.json is (tools/extract/golden/battle.c; see battle.json's notes for the engine, the sheets, the masks and the frames), as an encounter runs a battle. The flagship is init_sis's, built from GLOBAL_SIS's slots and crew (CrewEnlisted, the captain counted on top) as in an encounter; the Ilwrath init_ilwrath's, its crew held to its STARSHIP's (the Earth fight's is 7). Both are flown by keys (some steered by a pilot; the AI is item 4's), so the Ilwrath cloaks as it does outside the Earth fight.

input: as battle.json's, but each ship is the flagship, kind sis: crew (CrewEnlisted), bomb (CHMMR_BOMB_STATE), drives (11), jets (8) and modules (16) as sis.h numbers them (1 FUSION_THRUSTER, 2 TURNING_JETS, 3 CREW_POD, 4 STORAGE_BAY, 5 FUEL_TANK, 7 DYNAMO_UNIT, 8 SHIVA_FURNACE, 9 GUN_WEAPON, 10 BLASTER_WEAPON, 11 CANNON_WEAPON, 12 TRACKING_SYSTEM, 13 ANTIMISSILE_DEFENSE, 14 to 19 BOMB_MODULE_0 to 5; 20, 21 and 22 empty drive, jet and module slots); or the Ilwrath, kind ilwrath: crew.

frames: as battle.json's, each element with one more number at its end: its primitive's colour as MAKE_RGB15 makes it (red, green and blue, five bits each, red highest), -1 for one never set (UQM keeps a primitive per slot: an element starts with its slot's last colour). The Ilwrath's cloak fades through its colours. crew_enlisted: GLOBAL_SIS (CrewEnlisted) after the battle: uninit_sis writes crew_level - 1 there as free_ship frees the flagship's description, new_ship if it died, UninitShips at the battle's end if not (its crew held to its most when it warped in, spawn_ship's clamp), 65535 for none left, UQM's game over; bomb_carrier: BOMB_CARRIER after it (init_sis sets it when CHMMR_BOMB_STATE is 3).
